activity_description_check.name: activity_description_check
activity_description_check.value: "activity"."field" <> 'description' OR ("activity"."from_value" IS NULL AND "activity"."to_value" IS NULL)

attachments_filename_check.name: attachments_filename_check
attachments_filename_check.value: length("attachments"."filename") BETWEEN 1 AND 255 AND position('/' IN "attachments"."filename") = 0

agent_sessions_terminal_idx.name: agent_sessions_terminal_idx
agent_sessions_terminal_idx.where: "agent_sessions"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_sessions"."terminal_id" IS NOT NULL
